fields.Name: T139 - Action Detail Custom Form Parameters and Code Accordions
fields.Description: The custom ActionFormComponentExtended override with bespoke accordion sections (Parameters, Code & Generation, Runtime Config) and an embedded Run harness launcher — a distinct render path from the generic generated entity form.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Click an action (card/row) to open its full record. The custom Action detail form should render with a header showing the action name plus Status and Type chips, and collapsible accordion sections including a 'Parameters' section (Input Parameters / Output Parameters grids) and, for AI-Generated actions, a 'Code & Generation' section. Expand the Parameters accordion and confirm the input/output parameter sub-sections render. Seeing the custom form with its status/type header and the Parameters accordion is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Opening an action record shows a custom form with the action name and Status/Type status chips in the header
A collapsible 'Parameters' accordion is present and, when expanded, shows Input Parameters and Output Parameters sub-sections
For a Generated-type action a 'Code & Generation' section is available (or the section is appropriately absent for non-Generated actions)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
